content:
name: CI reliability diagnostics

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  startup:
    name: Apple Silicon quit observation (${{ matrix.attempt }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        attempt: [1, 2]
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
      MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: '13.0'
      DESKTOP_TARGET: macos-arm64
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          architecture: arm64
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@fc06bc1257f339d1d5d8b3a19a8cae5388b55320
        with:
          cache: true
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Prepare Electron through its public package entry
        run: pnpm --filter @kisaki3/desktop exec node -e "console.log(require('electron'))"
      - name: Build the merged desktop input
        run: pnpm desktop:build --target macos-arm64
      - name: Observe twenty startup and shutdown samples
        env:
          DEBUG: pw:api,pw:browser
        run: pnpm --filter @kisaki3/desktop test:performance
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        if: always()
        with:
          name: macos-arm64-quit-${{ matrix.attempt }}
          path: clients/desktop/app/test-results/
          if-no-files-found: error
